definitions.explanation: A chemical element essential for breathing and combustion.

examples.japanese: {酸素|さんそ}⟦{不足|ぶそく}→不足：03598_fusoku⟧

⟦{高山|こうざん}→高山：24746_kouzan⟧⟦では→では：02945_deha⟧{酸素|さんそ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{薄|うす}い→薄い：00764_usui⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦{体調|たいちょう}→体調：04644_taichou⟧⟦{管理|かんり}→管理：00178_kanri⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: In high mountains, oxygen is thin, so one needs to be careful about health management.

notes:
{酸素|さんそ} is the chemical element oxygen (O). The kanji mean {酸|さん} (acid) + {素|そ} (element).

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {酸素|さんそ}⟦マスク→マスク：05075_masuku⟧: oxygen mask
- {酸素|さんそ}⟦ボンベ→ボンベ：noentry⟧: oxygen tank/cylinder
- {酸素|さんそ}⟦{濃度|のうど}→濃度：00325_noudo⟧: oxygen concentration
- {酸素|さんそ}⟦{不足|ぶそく}→不足：03598_fusoku⟧: oxygen deficiency
- {酸素|さんそ}⟦{供給|きょうきゅう}→供給：02599_kyoukyuu⟧: oxygen supply

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {酸素|さんそ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{薄|うす}い→薄い：00764_usui⟧: oxygen is thin (at high altitudes)
- {酸素|さんそ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{吸|す}う→吸う：04394_suu⟧: to breathe in oxygen
